papers.title: General-purpose large language models outperform specialized clinical AI tools on medical benchmarks
papers.headline: General AI tools beat specialized medical AI on clinical knowledge tests.
papers.ml_angle: Frontier large language models—AI systems trained on diverse internet text—were compared against specialized medical AI using standardized medical tests and real clinical scenarios to see which approach better captures medical knowledge and clinical reasoning.

papers.title: TEAD1 condensates are transcriptionally inactive storage sites on the pericentromeric heterochromatin in cancer cells
papers.headline: Cancer cells store excess TEAD1 protein in inactive storage blobs inside the nucleus.

papers.title: Corylin promotes healthy aging via RAGA–mTOR suppression and sex-dependent activation of SIRT3
papers.headline: A natural compound called corylin extends lifespan and improves health in female mice by tweaking aging pathways.

papers.title: Preventing cancer requires more than a list of carcinogens
papers.headline: Stopping cancer needs understanding how risk factors work together, not just listing dangerous chemicals.

papers.title: How AI is reshaping discovery in maths and physics
papers.headline: AI is helping mathematicians and physicists ask better questions, not replacing human thinking.
papers.ml_angle: AI systems can quickly identify patterns in mathematical structures and physical data that would take humans years to find manually, helping researchers spot promising new directions to explore.

papers.title: Taming the inflamed heart
papers.headline: Doctors are learning to spot and treat heart inflammation using AI scans and new immune-targeting drugs.
papers.ml_angle: Artificial intelligence algorithms were trained to recognize patterns of inflammation in heart scans, allowing doctors to detect dangerous inflammation faster and more accurately than by eye alone.

papers.title: ArchVelo: archetypal velocity modeling for single-cell multi-omic trajectories
papers.headline: New tool maps how immune cells change during infection by reading their chemical switches.
papers.ml_angle: The algorithm uses machine learning to identify archetypal patterns in chromatin data and extrapolate them to predict how individual cells are changing, automating pattern recognition that would be impossible to do by hand.

papers.title: Spinal cord stimulation for upper limb motor function in people with chronic post-stroke hemiparesis: a feasibility trial
papers.headline: Electrical stimulation of the spinal cord helps stroke survivors regain arm strength and movement.

papers.title: Bypassing the VTA: Thalamic modulation of striatal dopamine prioritizes safety
papers.headline: Brain discovers a safety shortcut that overrides reward signals to avoid danger.

papers.title: Single-cell spatial pharmacobiology identifies conserved stromal barriers to therapeutic antibody delivery in human solid tumors
papers.headline: Scientists map why antibody cancer drugs get stuck outside tumors instead of reaching cancer cells.
papers.ml_angle: The researchers likely used machine learning to analyze the massive amounts of spatial protein data and identify patterns in which cell types and proteins consistently block antibody penetration across different tumors and patients.

papers.title: 15-strain live biotherapeutic product or same donor fecal microbiota transplant for recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection: a randomized phase 1b trial
papers.headline: Simple bacterial mixture works as well as full fecal transplant for stubborn C. difficile infections.

papers.title: Downplaying toxicities in cancer drug trials is not acceptable
papers.headline: Cancer drug trials must honestly report patient side effects, not just tumor shrinkage.

papers.title: Multi-ancestry transcriptome-wide association studies uncover insights into breast cancer genetics and biology
papers.headline: Researchers identify hidden genes that increase breast cancer risk across different populations.
papers.ml_angle: The study likely used computational machine learning to filter through vast amounts of genetic and expression data to predict which genes are causal targets of disease variants.

papers.title: Inference of upstream-mutation and metabolomic-signature causality identifies prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in pancreatic cancer
papers.headline: A blood-test signature of nine molecules predicts pancreatic cancer survival and reveals a new drug target.
papers.ml_angle: The researchers used machine learning (artificial intelligence trained on data) to identify which combinations of nine metabolites best predict patient survival and to uncover hidden cause-and-effect relationships between genes and blood chemistry.

papers.title: Pathogenic germline variants identify elevated cancer risk in pediatric patients referred for genetic testing
papers.headline: Genetic tests can now identify children at high risk of developing cancer early.
cancer_types: pediatric cancers (types not specified in abstract)

papers.title: Multimodal deep learning model for AI-based functional prognostic risk stratification in patients undergoing radical nephrectomy
papers.headline: AI learns to predict which kidney cancer patients can safely avoid removing their whole kidney.
papers.ml_angle: The AI model learned to recognize patterns in CT images and patient data that predict which kidney cancer patients will have good outcomes with kidney-sparing surgery, helping doctors decide whether full kidney removal is truly necessary.

papers.title: Scoring gene importance by interpreting single-cell foundation models
papers.headline: New AI tool identifies which genes matter most in individual cancer cells across studies.
cancer_types: general framework applicable to many cancer types
tested on leukemia and lymphoma cells
applicable to solid tumors through foundation model approach
papers.ml_angle: The AI learned patterns from millions of cancer cells across studies, then used a spotlight method to show which genes it relied on when deciding if a cell was important—turning a black box into something scientists can understand.

papers.title: A kinetics-based model of haematopoiesis reveals extrinsic regulation of skewed lineage output from stem cells
papers.headline: Blood stem cells' output is controlled by their environment, not just their own genetics.
papers.ml_angle: Mathematical computer models (simulations) were used to identify the underlying rules connecting stem cell speed of recovery with their preference for certain blood cell types.

papers.title: Long-term comparative analysis of AAV9-mediated gene replacement therapies for spinal muscular atrophy in mice
papers.headline: New gene therapy for muscle-wasting disease works better and safer than existing treatment in mice.

papers.headline: Breast cancers linked to inherited TP53 mutations evolve differently than sporadic cases.

papers.title: Pathogenic germline variations and cancer risks in pediatric patients referred for genetic testing
papers.headline: Genetic mutations inherited from parents predict which children will develop cancer.

papers.title: The uncritical adoption of AI in science is alarming — we urgently need guard rails
papers.headline: Scientists warn that blindly using AI in research risks making science worse, not better.
papers.ml_angle: The paper warns against uncritical use of machine learning (a type of AI that learns from data) in science, rather than presenting a new ML application for cancer research.

papers.title: Publisher Correction: Microbiota-induced T cell plasticity enables immune-mediated tumour control

papers.ml_angle: Machine learning algorithms were trained to recognize which peptide designs would successfully localize at condensate interfaces, enabling the discovery of design rules that would be impossible to find through manual analysis alone.

papers.title: CD84 is a specific target for acute myeloid leukemia CAR-T cell therapy
